comment: The look of every menu, panel, and label, and the colors of the health bar, the MP bar, and the hit flash of the battle screen (D-527, D-826, D-829, D-976). Game builds the Godot Theme from this file at load, and no theme resource file exists (G-6). Each color names a palette key of content/sprites/palette.json, so the screen keeps one palette (D-89, D-181). The player picks the body size, and the title is title_scale times the body (D-707). A notice slides in, holds, and fades over the ticks of the notice object, which count the ticks of the world (D-994, D-995). The map colors paint the dungeon map screen: a walked tile, a door, a save point, and the party (D-567, D-982). The gain and the loss color the stats of a piece of gear under the cursor of the gear window (D-1060). The pause dim shades the frame under the pause of a fight (D-1083).
